notes.title: Watch the developer play Bionic Tadpole
notes.notes:
[h2][h1]Hi! I'm SaGa76, the developer of Bionic Tadpole.[/h1][/h2]
On Saturday, June 18th I will be streaming the demo live, playing through all 3 stages made so far.
I will show you how to play Bionic Tadpole with some good pointers to start with when launching the demo. I'm developing the game using and learning the Gamemaker Studio 2 engine and Aseprite software as I go. So please join me on the 18th beginning at 2pm EDT.
